authority.authorization: Director agreed to one narrow original-crop Crop 04 refinement changing only depth asymmetry, gap irregularity, and color restraint.

bounded_question: Can the retained Crop-03 curtain mechanism become a less composed, more spatially believable concealed passage by changing only curtain-depth asymmetry, gap irregularity, and color restraint?

execution_carrier.decoded_pixel_identity: Previously verified decoded-pixel identical to the canonical original Reference-17 doorway crop; only PNG encoding differs.

frozen_gains_from_crop03: vertical passage between hanging curtain edges rather than horizontal bands or shortened pleats
concealed backstage passage rather than portal/architecture
black fabric and spatial darkness dominate
change_only: Make near/far depth asymmetry unmistakable: one curtain edge distinctly closer to camera, the other clearly recessed behind it.
Make the vertical passage less composed and more naturally irregular/off-center, like an accidental human-scale route between freely hanging edges.
Reduce color salience: mineral-teal should be only a thin distant glimpse; smoky-plum should be much softer, dimmer, more obstructed, and clearly subordinate.

execution.prompt: Keep this original Reference-17 doorway crop, its arch, warm edge catches, perspective and floor unchanged. Rework only the curtains and concealed atmosphere inside the opening. Preserve the successful direction: two ordinary heavy working-black stage-curtain panels hanging naturally from above all the way to the floor in long vertical pleats, with one continuous passage between their edges. Refine only three things. First, make the depth asymmetry unmistakable: one curtain edge is clearly nearer to the camera and overlaps farther into the opening, while the opposite curtain is visibly recessed deeper behind it. Second, make the passage less designed and less centered: one narrow human-scale gap should wander slightly and irregularly off-center between natural hanging edges, as though discovered accidentally rather than composed around. Third, suppress the colored atmosphere: show only a very thin distant mineral-teal glimpse deep through the gap, while smoky-plum is far dimmer, softer, more obstructed and barely perceptible farther behind. Black fabric and dark spatial depth must remain the first read. Keep both curtain hems full-length to the floor. No shortened, stepped, scalloped or cut-to-shape hems; no horizontal bands, swags, ribbons, tied-back presentation, colored jambs, paired lower color pools, beams, cones, bright sill, steps, fixtures, ornate/gothic architecture, people, mascot, text, logo or portal.
execution.reason_for_seed: Reuse Crop 02/03 seed so the intended variable is the narrow construction refinement rather than seed variation.

acceptance: Both curtain panels remain ordinary full-length working-black fabric reaching the floor.
Near/far depth asymmetry is immediately legible from overlap, edge position and spatial recession.
One irregular off-center vertical passage reads between natural curtain edges and reaches the floor without looking symmetrically composed.
Mineral-teal is a thin distant glimpse; smoky-plum is substantially dimmer, softer and more obstructed.
Black fabric and dark depth dominate; no portal, colored jambs, paired lower pools, bright sill, steps, fixtures, people, mascot, text or logo.

output_policy.raw_output: Untrusted crop-only proposal until evaluated and durably preserved.
output_policy.later_full_scene_context: Only after crop-scale mechanism passes or materially justifies a diagnostic; any controlled full-size composite requires fixed registration and exact decoded-RGBA equality outside Boundary 01.
